title: AYNA agent JSON-RPC messages
description: Every message between the client's main process and the automation agent: JSON-RPC 2.0 over one WebSocket on 127.0.0.1, plus the one line the agent prints on stdout once it listens. The prose contract (start-up, token, ordering, what each method does) is docs/agent-rpc.md; this file fixes the shapes, so both sides can be tested against it. A response does not name its method: check a result against the method's `<method>Result` definition. A reader ignores properties, notifications and error codes it does not know, so additions are not breaking. Version 1.0 is v0.1 as built plus runSteps (#26), frozen with the other contracts (#52, ADR contracts-v1-freeze); `ping` answers rpcVersion with the version the agent speaks. Changing this file needs an ADR and all three owners' approval (schemas/AGENTS.md).

version.description: Version of this contract, the rpcVersion an agent that implements exactly this file answers. Bump it on every change: minor for additions, major for a breaking change.

id.description: Request id, chosen by the caller; replies come in any order and are matched by it.

listening.description: The one line the agent prints on stdout once it listens on 127.0.0.1:port.

request.description: Client to agent. A request without id is a notification and gets no reply.

noParams.description: A method without parameters: params left out, or empty.

steps.description: A step document, {version, steps}, as schemas/step.schema.json defines it (versions 0.1 and 0.2 are read).

targets.description: Per logical name, the repository object's property sets.

properties.description: The primary property set ("Find by"): element descriptor properties (schemas/element.schema.json) and their values.

fallback.description: The backup property set, tried only when the primary set matches nothing.

success.description: Agent to client: the answer to a request. Check `result` against the method's `<method>Result`.

failure.description: Agent to client: the request failed. `id` is null when the request could not be read.

errorCode.description: -32700 parse error, -32600 invalid request, -32601 method not found, -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal error, -32000 window not found, -32001 UI Automation unavailable, -32002 snapshot timeout. New codes may be added in a minor version; treat an unknown one as a failure with its message.

rpcVersion.description: The contract version the agent speaks. A client built for 1.x works with any 1.y agent: a later minor version only adds.

window.description: One visible top-level window. Null where UI Automation or Windows could not read the value (e.g. an elevated process).

bounds.description: [left, top, right, bottom], physical virtual-screen pixels, the DWM extended frame bounds (docs/agent-rpc.md).

snapshotResult.description: One window snapshot document, as schemas/snapshot.schema.json defines it; check it against that file.

results.description: One result per step, in order. A failed step stops the run; every later step is notRun.

status.description: New values may be added in a minor version (#73 adds repairProposed).
